next_phase.why: Multi-agent maturity audit (run wf_ebc554f3-006; aborted on schema cap but 4/5 reviewers completed, unanimous, recovered from transcripts) confirmed the user's critique: Backtester=usable, Optimizer=amateur, ML Pattern Finder=amateur/toy. next_phase.fix_thesis: Make features RELATIVE/NORMALIZED & comparable (validated, unanimous): volume/SMA20(volume), EMA slope in ATR units, distance-from-MA in ATR, z-score, rolling percentile rank, n-bar return. Implement as NEW INDICATOR TYPES in the registry so builder + ML + plotter all get them via the single-source pipeline. Then add ML holdout + Wilson/BH-FDR significance, then optimizer validation (Deflated Sharpe, parameter-stability heatmap, walk-forward, Monte-Carlo).

phases.A_normalized_feature_library: DONE (2026-06-27): 6 new indicator types added — 'Ratio to SMA' (x/SMA, use Volume source for volume-vs-avg), 'Distance from MA (ATR)', 'MA Slope (ATR)', 'Z-Score', 'Percentile Rank', 'Return (n-bar)'. Implemented via config.INDICATOR_PLACEMENT(panel)/PANEL_GUIDES + indicators.INDICATOR_TYPES/PARAM_SPECS + 6 vectorised helpers (ratio_to_sma_vec/dist_from_ma_atr_vec/ma_slope_atr_vec/zscore_vec/pctile_rank_vec/ret_n_vec) + emit_indicator branches + compiler._namespace injection. Builder/ML/plotter all get them via the single-source pipeline; they render in own panels (v6.1). tests/test_features.py (4 tests: formula match, panel placement, codegen+compile+backtest, cross-asset comparability). Full suite 45/45 green.
phases.B_ml_rigor: DONE (2026-06-28): ml/patterns.py rewritten + ml_finder.py + indicators.partition_features/CROSS_ASSET_COMPARABLE_TYPES + batch.extract_trades Source tagging + config ML_SAMPLE_FLOOR/ML_HOLDOUT_FRAC/ML_FDR_ALPHA. (1) ML finder DEFAULTS to normalized cross-asset features (v7 set + bounded oscillators); raw/absolute features are warned and per-instrument z-scored (groupby Source) BEFORE bulk concat. (2) Time-ordered holdout (70/30, default) OR walk-forward k-fold (TimeSeriesSplit): rules mined on train, scored OOS via dt leaf->predicate re-evaluation. (3) Gate per leaf: OOS sample-size floor (30) -> one-sided binomial vs OOS baseline -> Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (alpha 0.10) -> Wilson lower-bound must still beat baseline. Survivors -> result['rules'] (OOS win-rate, wilson_lb, p/q, train vs OOS); failures -> result['candidate_rules'] with reject reason. XGBoost importance kept descriptive (full matrix, NOT gated). Helpers wilson_lower_bound/binom_sf/benjamini_hochberg exported. tests/test_ml_rigor.py (11, synthetic+portable). Legacy positional mine_patterns call + old ML tests still green (parity). Verified: full pytest 56 green, AppTest renders ml_finder, real-RELIANCE end-to-end drive (defaulting/Source/holdout/k-fold/gate all correct; thin single-instrument data correctly yields 0 promoted, noise demoted). Effort M.

Verified: full pytest 67 green, AppTest renders backtester (26 metrics), real-RELIANCE drive (PSR/grid-heatmap/Optuna-DSR=27%/MC-bands-bracket-realized/WFE=-1.2 all correct; the overfit EMA-crossover is correctly flagged). key_decisions: Keep backtesting.py as the engine (do NOT swap to NautilusTrader/VectorBT).

Keep Plotly for charts; do NOT pivot to Bokeh or TradingView Lightweight Charts (multi-agent debate verdict: messiness was a DESIGN bug, fixed in v6.1; st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in Streamlit 1.58; LWC is a third-party iframe with quirks). Optional native-Bokeh 'Pro chart' embed kept behind a toggle only.
Indicator placement (overlay vs own panel) is single-sourced in config.INDICATOR_PLACEMENT.
Default download save format = Both (Parquet + CSV); CSV can go to a separate folder.
Vectorised indicators are proven byte-equal to originals (test_parity.py); toggle via indicators.USE_VECTORIZED.
Local tools work without broker login; only live downloaders/options need auth.
modular.json is the granular file-by-file index, updated via .workflow/modlog.py (env MODLOG_AGENT=name; commands: file/log/feature/speed/phase/agent).
gotchas: pandas >= 3: in-place float assignment into an int64 column raises (fixed corporate_actions by casting OHLCV to float first).
ML per-trade return column is 'ReturnPct' (fraction), NOT 'Return [%]' (that's overall stats).
backtesting.py Position has NO .entry_price; use self.trades[-1].entry_price (trailing-stop codegen).
_prev_position_size is SIGNED (negative for shorts) — short trailing fresh-entry guard is '>= 0'.
st.cache_data deep-copies its return each rerun; master list uses cache_resource + session_state to avoid 53MB copies.
Headless Chrome in this sandbox cannot screenshot Plotly/canvas (kaleido fails to launch Chrome); rely on AppTest + structural tests; use a real browser for visual confirmation.
Streamlit st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in 1.58; embed Bokeh via components.html(file_html(...)).
Tests hardcode the D:\simpleton data path (not portable to CI/other machines) — a known deferred item.
Windows multiprocessing: spawn children import the worker module; run ProcessPool tests via a real .py with __main__ guard (tests/manual_batch_check.py), not heredoc.
completed_in_v6_and_v6_1: PERF: master-list cache_resource + session_state + vectorised classifier (3.0s->0.3s) + 24h disk cache (startup ~10s->0.8s); selector per-class slices (keystroke ~90ms->33ms); WAL once; resample vectorised.
